title: Prospective registry study to evaluate recurrences and complications after surgical treatment of male stress incontinence with DynaMesh®-PRM mesh implants
summary: The overall objective of the registry study is to evaluate the performance and safety of the product in routine use. This approach fulfills the legal obligation to proactively monitor the post-market safety and performance of the product as required by the MDR since May 2021.

interventions.name:
-Adult male patients of legal age who are to have a DynaMesh® PRM (visible) mesh implant due to stress incontinence.
-Light to moderate incontinence (guideline-compliant)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
The informed consent form has been signed by the patient after verbal and written explanation for participation in the registry study.
Exclusion criteria:
Pre-operated patients with surgical incontinence therapies.
Since this is an observation of routine clinical practice, no further exclusion criteria are defined.
